verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a first-party Zapier integration that uses its webhooks to fetch transcripts automatically when meetings are processed. That gives a real path for notes to reach the thousands of apps Zapier supports, and webhook support is documented for transcription completion and for team-wide meetings via Super Admin. The pack has no evidence of native Slack or Notion integrations that push notes into channels or pages. missing for 10: native Slack channel delivery, native Notion page export, Zapier trigger/action detail beyond a one-line doc, independent or hands-on corroboration.
